purpose: Prompts for experiments/moe_greedy_smoke.py (#198). P0 is the v17 campaign smoke and the positive control of the degeneration rule: it MUST read repetitive on both arms. P1-P3 are content-bearing passages that end mid-sentence, sent as raw completions the way P0 was. P4-P6 ask for the same content through the checkpoint's own chat template (the serve applies chat_template.jinja): the checkpoint is the instruct model, and a raw continuation is not the interface it was trained on. Through that template the model opens every reply with a <think> trace before its answer and the template has no switch to turn that off, so P4-P6 carry a budget the answer is reached within; P0-P3 keep the campaign's short budget, because a cycle shows inside it. Every prompt is run on both arms and every completion is kept, whichever way it reads.
